svg.title: Starmux — Cloud MCP clients. Real computers on earth.
svg.desc: Editable vector diagram: cloud MCP clients connect through Direct HTTPS or a Secure Tunnel to independent self-hosted Starmux instances. Each instance acts as programmable MCP middleware for policies, routing and tool adapters before reaching MCP servers such as Desktop Commander on real macOS, Windows and Linux computers.

g.text: Use Direct HTTPS or Secure Tunnel to let cloud MCP clients securely access MCP servers and tools on your computers anywhere on earth.

g.title: Client, transport and gateway connection routes

g.text: Programmable MCP middleware on each computer
MCP servers running on your machines

g.aria-label: WorkBuddy icon vectorized from the uploaded official PNG

g.text: Your gateways. Your machines. Your data.
Work with your files, terminal, Git and services
Define policies, routing and tool adapters
Direct HTTPS avoids a managed relay. Secure Tunnel uses OpenAI forwarding. Multi-computer orchestration is a deployment pattern, not a single built-in unified control plane.
